name: foot4-connect-instagram-dark
js: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.cfootapp[aria-label^="Connect Instagram"]'); if (b) b.click(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); })()

name: foot5-connected-linkedin-cream
js: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.cfootapp[aria-label^="LinkedIn"]'); if (b) b.click(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); })()

name: foot6-all-dark
js: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.cfootapp[aria-label$="more connections"]'); if (b) b.click(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); })()

name: foot7-all-posthog-light
js: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.cfootapp[aria-label$="more connections"]'); if (b) b.click(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.connpop .cprojitem')).find(x => (x.textContent || '').includes('PostHog')); if (row) row.click(); setTimeout(r, 600); }, 400)); })()

name: foot8-typing-dark
js: (() => { const ta = document.querySelector('.stagebox textarea'); if (!ta) return; Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(ta, 'Draft three LinkedIn posts about the v0.128 release and schedule them for next week.'); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); ta.focus(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); })()
